defects.claim: A falsy look-ahead view (e.g. numeric 0) is ignored because the optional argument is checked for truthiness, so its tiles are never prefetched
defects.scenario: With a numeric-position scheme, update(5, 0) ignores the look-ahead view 0, so tiles at position zero are never prefetched by that call

defects.claim: planeFloor drops a level without checking that the finer grid already fits the tile limit, so an aligned box gets a coarser floor than the finest that fits
defects.scenario: Tile size 512, limit of two tiles per side, bounds [0, 0, 512, 512]: returns one level-0 tile though level 1 covers the bounds with two tiles per side, giving a less detailed stand-in
